decisionSchema.description: Prospective artifact schema only; no application or database schema is changed. Nullable missing metadata is allowed only for provisional NEEDS_EVIDENCE/REVISE records.
decisionSchema.qualificationGuard: An exact exposed model identity/version, actual time, current approved bundle, all required resolved/PASS decisions, valid auditory/provenance evidence, fresh correction review and zero open P0/P1 are mandatory for AI_QUALIFIED. A provisional null modelVersion can never qualify.

policy.digestRule: SHA-256 recursively sorted JSON excluding own digest,arrays preserved;technical record integrity,not signature

digestDefinitions.bundle: For seven changed Lessons use exact approved content successor canonical projection/hash;MG02-L2 uses frozen Gate B control bundle identity. DescriptorDigest is local integrity only and is not substituted for official bundle IDs.
digestDefinitions.matrix: SHA-256 canonical coverageMatrix only; every decision binds this same digest. Matrix rows contain identities/input bindings, no self-referential decision digest.
digestDefinitions.decision: SHA-256 canonical full decision excluding only its own decisionSha256.
digestDefinitions.document: SHA-256 canonical full review excluding only documentSha256; arrays preserved; UTF-8 JSON.stringify without trailing newline. These are technical integrity digests, never signatures.

transitions.guard: Matching successor approval and exact input snapshot recorded.

resultLifecycle.rejectSemantics: REJECT is an item verdict for unsuitable/invalid evidence or irreparable task; it prevents lesson qualification without inventing a CLI lifecycle state.
resultLifecycle.newBundleReviewRule: Append fresh exact-version decisions using supersedesDecisionId only for this successor; no old human/AI verdict transfer. Preserve old records and human claims.
resultLifecycle.rollback: Prospectively suspend qualification policy and append withdrawal/superseding result with actual time/reason; never erase old human/AI history or reactivate changed-bundle signoffs.

limitations: No invented source provenance or master mapping.
WAV phonetics needs expert listening or suitable separately authorized evidence; owner sound QA remains reported history.

gateC.ordering: investigation -> correction -> fresh analysis -> eligible policy adjudication -> separately approved real Gate C -> separately authorized closeout
gateC.learnerCalibrationBoundary: Textual task suitability can be reviewed before Gate C; real comprehension/difficulty/active-time evidence gates R1.2b readiness after eight eligible AI-qualified lessons. Do not make Gate C an upstream dependency of those lesson reviews.

evidenceSnapshot.concurrencyRule: Worker stopped before coordinator assumed exclusive writes to these3 files;read-only independent reviewer has no write access.

coverage.meaning: All current-source items analysed;PASS denotes bounded textual analysis only,not final qualification or runtime grading.
